title: Conservation Agriculture
claim: Conservation agriculture combines minimum soil disturbance, permanent soil cover and species diversification, supporting soil functions and biodiversity.
mechanism: Reduced disturbance, continuous cover and diversification influence organic inputs, habitat, nutrient cycling and water processes.
keywords: soil cover crop rotation biodiversity carbon moisture monoculture

title: Soil Organic Cover
claim: Cover crops and surface residues can protect soil, add organic matter, improve structure and support biodiversity.
mechanism: Vegetative cover reduces exposure and contributes organic inputs while supporting infiltration and biological activity.
keywords: cover crops residues organic carbon soil moisture biodiversity erosion

title: Soil Organic Matter
claim: Soil organic matter influences structure, porosity, water infiltration, moisture holding capacity, biological activity and nutrient availability.
mechanism: Organic matter links physical, chemical and biological soil processes.
keywords: organic matter soil carbon water infiltration microbes nutrients

title: Agroforestry
claim: Agroforestry integrates trees with crops or livestock and can support soil fertility, water regulation, biodiversity and landscape resilience.
mechanism: Multiple vegetation layers create habitat and complementary resource use while adding biomass.
keywords: agroforestry trees crops habitat biodiversity carbon drought water

title: Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services
claim: Biological diversity supports decomposition, nutrient cycling, soil structure and pest regulation; rotations, mixtures and agroforestry can increase ecological diversity.
mechanism: More diverse biological communities provide a wider set of ecosystem functions.
keywords: species richness habitat diversity soil biodiversity crop rotation intercropping

title: Climate Change and Land
claim: Climate change, land use, biodiversity and water processes are interconnected and land management can influence multiple environmental outcomes.
mechanism: Climate and land-management decisions interact through water, ecosystem and carbon processes.
keywords: climate land water biodiversity drought rainfall temperature

title: Land Degradation and Restoration
claim: Land degradation and restoration require integrated assessment of ecological processes and biodiversity.
mechanism: Land condition, biodiversity and ecosystem functions are coupled.
keywords: land degradation restoration biodiversity habitat ecosystem
